response.justification: While the candidate brings 19 years of general software development experience and expertise in some advantageous technologies (React, Node.js), there is a critical mismatch with the role's core requirements. C++ expertise, the primary job requirement, is severely outdated (6 months in 2014-2015, 10+ years ago). Additionally, the candidate lacks any background in industrial automation, embedded systems, or manufacturing domains—areas central to the role. The security expertise required (SDL, IEC 62443 standards) is also not evident. The career trajectory has moved deliberately away from systems programming toward web/backend development, the opposite direction needed for this position.
strengths: 19 years of extensive software development experience across diverse domains (web, backend, data systems, full-stack) demonstrating senior-level expertise and ability to architect and deliver complex solutions

Demonstrated mastery in advantageous technologies with React and Node.js experience spanning 3-8+ years, showing capability in modern development practices and frameworks relevant to the role's tech stack

Strong software craftsmanship culture evidenced by creating educational workshops, testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial), mentoring multiple teams, and building open-source projects—indicating quality mindset and technical leadership
concerns: Critical gap in C++ expertise: only 6 months of experience from 2014-2015, now significantly outdated; has not worked in modern C++ systems programming for 10+ years, making primary job requirement inaccessible

Zero industrial automation, embedded systems, IoT, or manufacturing background; career focused on web backends, fintech platforms, and AI infrastructure rather than high-performance systems and industrial applications

No demonstrated experience with required security practices: no evidence of Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL), IEC 62443 standards, industrial cybersecurity concepts, secure coding for industrial environments, or concurrent/multi-threaded systems expertise

key_factors.factor: Industrial automation and embedded systems background
Senior-level experience and technical leadership capabilities
